lines.zh: 骨头在夜里替猎号打拍子。
lines.en: My bones keep time for a horn I cannot hear.

lines.zh: 我踏过霜草，缰绳是空的。
lines.en: I cross frost-bitten grass with an empty rein.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩出白骨的回声。
lines.en: Every step knocks an echo out of my own ribs.

lines.zh: 队伍在前，我只是最后那根骨头。
lines.en: The hunt rides ahead; I am its last loose bone.

lines.zh: 草叶穿过我的肋骨，我不在意。
lines.en: Grass slips between my ribs and I do not care.
My master does not halt, so neither do I.

lines.zh: 夜风把我的关节吹得格格响。
lines.en: Night wind rattles every joint I still own.

lines.zh: 我走在猎犬踏烂的旧路上。
lines.en: I walk the rutted road the hounds already tore.

lines.zh: 前方有活物，脚自己加快了。
lines.en: Something lives ahead; my feet speed up on their own.
The soil knows me; I have passed here before.
I have no lungs, yet I still heave for breath.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的指骨，十根都在。
lines.en: I count my finger bones; all ten are still here.

lines.zh: 大灵体沉默时，风也停了。
lines.en: When the great spirit is silent, even the wind stops.

lines.zh: 我记得生前跑过同样的林子。
lines.en: I remember running this same woods while alive.
Bone does not tire, but still I wait.

lines.zh: 猎号再响一次，我就起身。
lines.en: One more horn call and I rise again.

lines.zh: 月亮照着我缺了半块的颅骨。
lines.en: Moonlight fills the gap in my broken skull.

lines.zh: 我听见异界那边有狗在叫。
lines.en: I hear hounds baying from beyond the other side.

lines.zh: 这具身体是借来的，我小心用。
lines.en: This body is borrowed; I use it carefully.

lines.zh: 主人不动，我便是一根柱子。
lines.en: While my master stands still, I am a post.

lines.zh: 白骨影子先落在我脚边。
lines.en: My white shadow lands a step before me.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的胸腔，像吹笛。
lines.en: Wind pipes through my empty chest like a flute.

lines.zh: 我把断掉的肋骨按回原处。
lines.en: I push a snapped rib back into its place.

lines.zh: 夜里静得能听见自己走路。
lines.en: The night is quiet enough to hear my own steps.

lines.zh: 彼界的灰还卡在我颈骨里。
lines.en: Otherworld ash still grits inside my neck bone.

lines.zh: 我等着猎犬先把气味咬住。
lines.en: I wait for the hounds to bite the scent first.

lines.zh: 活人的眼睛会动，真奇怪。
lines.en: Living eyes move on their own; how strange.

lines.zh: 你身上有热气，我闻到了。
lines.en: You carry warmth; I can smell it from here.
Do not look back; my master watches you too.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为我不能开口。
lines.en: I stare because I no longer have a voice.
Your pulse is beating far too fast for me.

lines.zh: 你靴子沾的泥，我都看清。
lines.en: I can see the mud packed on your boots.
Living hands still tremble; mine cannot.

lines.zh: 我数过你的脚步，一共十七。
lines.en: I counted your steps; there were seventeen.
Do not hold that torch so high, hunter.

lines.zh: 你的脸在白骨眼里很清楚。
lines.en: Your face shows clearly in these hollow sockets.

lines.zh: 我记得恐惧是什么味道。
lines.en: I still remember what fear used to taste like.

lines.zh: 多站一会儿，我还没看够。
lines.en: Stand a while longer; I am not done looking.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的锁骨。
lines.en: That blow snapped my collarbone clean through.
The pain is old; I still know its shape.
Do not stop; I am still standing here.

lines.zh: 你削掉我一角颅骨，无妨。
lines.en: You chipped a corner off my skull; no matter.

lines.zh: 我记下这一击的位置了。
lines.en: I have noted exactly where that landed.
No blood in this wound, only wind.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起自己的死。
lines.en: That blow recalls the way I died.
My master did not turn; I cannot fall.
You struck true, but far too lightly.
My bone is split but still held together.
Bread for me? I have no tongue to taste it.
Bones do not eat; spare yourself the effort.

lines.zh: 你举的胡萝卜，我认不得。
lines.en: I do not even recognize the carrot you raise.
I follow only the hunt horn.

lines.zh: 食物收买不了已死的人。
lines.en: Food cannot buy a man who already died.
Take it away; that smell only irritates me.

lines.zh: 我曾爱吃，现在只剩习惯。
lines.en: I once loved eating; only habit is left.
Feed me and my master will laugh first.
An empty gut suits my empty hands.
Keep your bait in your pocket, hunter.
Do not shove me; my bones shed dust.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我第三节肋骨歪了。
lines.en: You hit me and my third rib slipped sideways.
I am too light; one bump tilts me over.
Steady yourself; I am not a wall.

lines.zh: 两副骨架相碰，咔的一声。
lines.en: Two skeletons meet and one sharp click.

lines.zh: 我扶正颅骨，再看你一眼。
lines.en: I straighten my skull, then look at you again.
The hunt leaves no gaps; step aside.
You just stepped on my toe bone.
Do not walk so close; my joints are loose.
That knock cost me two of my teeth.
I am bone; such things are not for me.
The hunt does not breed; it only collects bone.
A partner? I have only a master.
Do not court me; I am entirely cold.

lines.zh: 我的婚约随皮肉一起烂了。
lines.en: My betrothal rotted away with my flesh.
The otherworld has no marriage bed, only roads.
Whatever warmth I had stayed across the grave.
I ride beside the night wind only.
Drop it; the horn is about to sound.
Empty ribs cannot hold anyone close.
I pick up an arrowhead and put it back.
A full hand cannot draw a bow.
This coin is useless to a dead man.
Only fallen leaves here; I leave them.
The sword you dropped does not interest me.
My finger bones are loose; I cannot grip.
Carrying loot would make me fall behind.
I retrieve my skull and set it straight.
This bone was a comrade's; I return it.
Hunters gather much; I gather almost nothing.
Found you; warmth is a poor hiding place.

lines.zh: 主人抬手，我知道该谁了。
lines.en: My master lifts a hand; I know the prey.
Run, then; I will count to three first.
I smell sweat, and it smells very fresh.
Where the horn points is exactly where you stand.
Do not hide behind that tree; I heard you.
Your torchlight sold your shadow to me.
Target set; every bone in me tightens.
In life I chased deer much like this.
This quarry is worth the run.

lines.zh: 你退到栅栏边，我照样过去。
lines.en: Back to the fence; I still come through.
Master, there is a living one over here.

lines.zh: 你的心跳替我打了拍子。
lines.en: Your heartbeat keeps the tempo for my chase.
The hunt fans out; your road is already closed.

lines.zh: 粉笔圈合上，你就算在内了。
lines.en: The chalk circle closes, and you are counted in.

lines.zh: 书页翻到写你名字那行。
lines.en: The page turns to the line bearing your name.
The hounds bark first; only then do I raise my head.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝替你报了名。
lines.en: The twig you snapped has signed you up.

lines.zh: 别数我们，我们比看着多。
lines.en: Don't count us; we are more than we look.

lines.zh: 主人在看，我不能空手回去。
lines.en: The master watches; I cannot return empty-handed.
I walk slowly; your fear can keep pace.
The arrow is nocked; the string is old.
The harder you breathe, the steadier I get.
Do not watch my feet; watch my hand.

lines.zh: 我绕到你左边，再绕回来。
lines.en: I circle left of you, then circle back.
My master has not ordered it; I wait.
Your shield will not stop bare bone.

lines.zh: 我在等一个抬手的机会。
lines.en: I am waiting for one clean opening.
I already scouted the way you would flee.

lines.zh: 你的盾抬高了，腋下是空的。
lines.en: Your shield rose; your armpit is wide open.
Only three steps stand between us now.

lines.zh: 我踩碎落叶之前，就到了。
lines.en: I arrive before the leaf finishes cracking.

lines.zh: 猎犬负责叫，我负责靠近。
lines.en: The hounds bark; I do the closing in.
You wait for help; I wait for the wind.
I have fitted a fresh bowstring.

lines.zh: 圆规的边缘，你最好别踩。
lines.en: Best not step on the rim of the circle.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，一步，两步。
lines.en: I count your steps: one, two.

lines.zh: 你身后那条影子是我的。
lines.en: That shadow behind you is mine.

lines.zh: 我等猎犬把你赶到空地。
lines.en: I wait for the hounds to drive you into the open.

lines.zh: 灯灭的时候，我离你更近。
lines.en: When the lamp dies, I am closer to you.
The horn counts this stroke out for me.
My fingers leave a white line across you.
Do not cover up; the second lands on your shoulder.
My fist has no flesh, only bone.
You retreat, and I strike with your retreat.
Bone meets bone, and you break first.

lines.zh: 这一击为了异界的旧账。
lines.en: This one is for an old debt in the otherworld.
Did you hear that little crack just now?

lines.zh: 我的指节比你想象的重。
lines.en: My knuckles are heavier than they look.
Withdrawing now; I fall back to the rear.
Hunters bleed too; how refreshing to see.

lines.zh: 我没用力，骨头自己冲的。
lines.en: I barely pushed; the bone lunged by itself.

lines.zh: 这一记瞄准了你的手腕。
lines.en: This one was aimed at your sword wrist.
Kneel if you must; I can still reach you.

lines.zh: 猎号响了，我从土里爬出。
lines.en: The horn sounds; I climb out of the soil.
The bones arrived; the flesh never followed.
My master called, and I stood up.

lines.zh: 异界的门缝只够一根骨头。
lines.en: The otherworld's gap was only wide enough for bone.
Night has come, and so has the Wild Hunt.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着坟里的凉气。
lines.en: I still carry the cold of the grave on me.
It took me a long while to gather this frame.

lines.zh: 谁把我剩下的肋骨放这了？
lines.en: Who left my missing ribs lying out here?
The hunt was one short, and that was me.
When my eyes opened, the moon was red.
Do not fear; I merely arrived early.
Soil is packed between my teeth; unpleasant.

lines.zh: 又一场长夜，又一副骨头。
lines.en: Another long night, another set of bones.

lines.zh: 我从白骨堆里认出了自己。
lines.en: I recognized myself in that pile of white bone.
The chalk lines were drawn before I came through.

lines.zh: 书页合上，彼界的门就关了。
lines.en: The book closes, and the Otherworld door shuts.

lines.zh: 我借来的骨头，凉得刚好。
lines.en: These borrowed bones are just cold enough.
Seven candles were lit; I counted them.

lines.zh: 谁在阵外喊我的旧名字。
lines.en: Someone outside the circle calls my old name.

lines.zh: 我从纸页的背面翻出来。
lines.en: I climb out from the back of the page.
Fire only burns the moss off my bones.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我把肋骨捡回去。
lines.en: I fell apart and gathered my ribs back up.
Water cannot fill a chest this hollow.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我震成了几堆骨。
lines.en: The blast shook me into several piles of bone.
An arrow sticks between my ribs, stuck fast.

lines.zh: 法术让我的骨头自己响。
lines.en: Magic makes my own bones rattle against me.

lines.zh: 我早就不饿了，只是虚弱。
lines.en: I stopped being hungry long ago; only weak.

lines.zh: 雷把我照得骨头都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning lit every bone in me white.

lines.zh: 虚空里连骨头也留不下。
lines.en: Even bone leaves nothing behind in the void.
